text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait Airways Corp (KAC) denies a newspaper report that the national flag carrier was heading towards bankruptcy and says assets exceed 700 million dinars ($2.31 billion).
- Egypt's Foreign Minister Amr Moussa due in Kuwait on Thursday for a six-hour visit.

- Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al- Sabah will fly to Italy on Thursday to continue recuperation, due back in Kuwait in May, informed sources say. Sheikh Saad flew to London last month after a colon surgery in Kuwait.
- Parliamentarian says a draft law urging officials to account for their financial wealth will be completed soon.
- Saudi Arabia announced that April 16 would be the climax of the annual Moslem haj pilgrimage.
- Kuwait Airways plans 56 flights to transport pilgrims.
